observations: Photo 0 shows the retail packaging for a 'TWO LION' Electric Steam Iron.
The box indicates the manufacturer is Zhejiang Oudi Machine Co., Ltd.
The actual iron is not visible in the photo; only the box is shown.
The image on the box depicts a gravity-feed style industrial iron.

claims.evidence: This is a performance claim that cannot be verified through a photo of a box.

risks.risk: The box may be empty, or the iron inside may be used, damaged, or a different model.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual iron outside of the box.

risks.risk: Industrial gravity-feed irons require a water tank and hose to function; these may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing the water tank, hose, and any included accessories.

risks.risk: The heating element or steam mechanism may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the iron plugged in, heating up, and emitting steam.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual iron out of the box.
Photo of the water tank, hose, and silicone rest pad.
Video of the iron powered on and steaming.
response.reason: The seller has only provided a photo of the box. Without seeing the actual iron and its necessary accessories (tank and hose), it is impossible to verify the condition or even the presence of the item.
